What Does “Not on GamStop” Mean?

The term “not on GamStop” refers to casinos that do not participate in the GamStop self-exclusion scheme, allowing players who have opted for self-exclusion to potentially access these sites. However, it is essential to note that these casinos may not hold a UKGC licence, which provides certain protections for players. Instead, they may be licensed under different jurisdictions, which can vary significantly in terms of player safety and regulations.
